[Company name masked] is looking for a Graduate Research Assistant (GA). The job duties include serving as a teaching assistant for Vertically Integrated Projects (VIP), as well as a research assistant for ongoing projects. For the VIP, the student will be required to actively engage with the research projects, participate and attend the general meetings once a week, participate in preparing lecture materials, project materials and presentations, and help with research team coordination, and grading the research project, following the VIP requirements.
The position also includes work with research faculty in ongoing research projects in data collection, data analysis, modeling and literature reviews. As a part of job responsibilities, the GA will help with building and setting up prototype installations when a project requires, project logistics, and attend research sites for ongoing research tasks. This might include sensors installation and data monitoring. The role also includes supervision of students and managing of sub-tasks. Preferred areas of expertise include Modeling and Simulation, Sustainability, and Healthcare analytics.

For the VIP, the student will actively engage with research projects, attend general meetings once a week, help prepare lecture materials and presentations, assist with research team coordination, and grade research projects following VIP requirements.
The position also includes working with research faculty on data collection, data analysis, modeling, and literature reviews. The GA will help build and set up prototype installations when needed, support project logistics, and attend research sites for ongoing tasks, which may include sensor installation and data monitoring. The role also involves supervising students and managing sub-tasks. Preferred areas of expertise include Modeling and Simulation, Sustainability, and Healthcare Analytics. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with research methods and technical work.
cond_0185.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Pursuing a Master's degree or PhD in Engineering, Architecture, Public Policy, Sciences, or related fields
Must be registered for at least 12 credit hours during working semesters
Must have a 3.0 or higher cumulative GPA
Background and skill set in modeling and data analytics
Experience with research methods, statistical analysis, and data collection
Skills in programming languages and modeling and simulation
Ability to serve as a teaching assistant for Vertically Integrated Projects
Ability to clearly communicate technical ideas
Ability to work in on-site data collection
Ability to build prototypes and physical models
Preferred Requirements
Experience and participation in the Vertically Integrated Projects (VIP) Program
Experience as a teaching assistant
Experience in 1 or more programming languages
Task / team leadership experience
Experience in the areas of sustainability and healthcare analytics
Experience with 3D modeling, spatial analysis, GIS, and Agent-based simulation
Ability to learn complex engineering concepts
cond_0185.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0185.values: We value creating outcomes that are useful, fair, and mindful of the people they affect. We aim to approach our work with responsibility and respect.

The role involves serving as a teaching assistant for Vertically Integrated Projects (VIP) and supporting ongoing research projects. For the VIP, the GA will engage with research projects, attend weekly general meetings, help prepare lecture and project materials, support research team coordination, and handle grading in line with VIP requirements.
The position also involves working with research faculty on data collection, data analysis, modeling, and literature reviews. The GA will assist with building and setting up prototype installations when required, support project logistics, and attend research sites for ongoing tasks, which may include sensor installation and data monitoring. The role also includes supervising students and managing sub-tasks. Preferred areas of expertise include Modeling and Simulation, Sustainability, and Healthcare Analytics.

The job duties include serving as a teaching assistant for Vertically Integrated Projects (VIP), as well as a research assistant for ongoing projects. For the VIP, the student will be required to actively engage with the research projects, participate and attend the general meetings once a week, participate in preparing lecture materials, project materials and presentations, and help with research team coordination, and grading the research project, following the VIP requirements.
The position also includes work with research faculty in ongoing research projects in data collection, data analysis, modeling and literature reviews. As a part of job responsibilities, the GA will help with building and setting up prototype installations when a project requires, project logistics, and attend research sites for ongoing research tasks. This might include sensors installation and data monitoring. The role also includes supervision of students and managing of sub-tasks. Preferred areas of expertise include Modeling and Simulation, Sustainability, and Healthcare analytics.
cond_0624.requirements:
Pursuing a Master's degree or PhD in Engineering, Architecture, Public Policy, Sciences or related fields, or equivalent practical experience
Must be registered for at least 12 credit hours with your university during working semesters
Must be enrolled full-time (12 credit hours) during working semesters
Must have a 3.0 or higher cumulative GPA
Some background in modeling and data analytics; candidates still building these skills are welcome to apply
Familiarity with research methods, statistical analysis, and data collection
Working knowledge of programming languages and modeling and simulation tools
Willingness to serve as a teaching assistant for Vertically Integrated Projects
Some exposure to or participation in the Vertically Integrated Projects (VIP) Program
Some experience as a teaching assistant, or openness to developing in that role
Experience with 1 or more programming languages
Some experience with task or team coordination; leadership skills can be developed on the job
Background in sustainability and/or healthcare analytics is helpful
Familiarity with 3D modeling, spatial analysis, GIS, or agent-based simulation is a plus
Ability to learn complex engineering concepts over time
Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly, with a willingness to improve
Ability to work in on-site data collection settings
Ability to help build prototypes and physical models
cond_0624.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
